import torch, hydra, tempfile, functools, importlib.metadata as md
torch.set_num_threads(4)
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
OmegaConf.register_new_resolver('eval',eval,replace=True)
from napari_dare3d import _api as api
from napari_dare3d._release_models import release_segmentation_scale_mode
from unittest.mock import patch
(out/'temp').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
config=api._load_inference_cfg(str(cfgdir),str(movies['movie_I2'][0].parent),'gpu',checkpoint_path=str(ckpt))
model=api._build_model(config,torch.device('cuda:0'),stage='segmentation')
save('model_load.json',{'checkpoint':ckpt,'sha256':sha(ckpt),'network_keys':len(model.net.state_dict()),'device':str(next(model.net.parameters()).device),'training':model.net.training,'torch':torch.__version__,'cuda':torch.version.cuda,'monai':md.version('monai'),'cudnn':torch.backends.cudnn.version(),'cudnn_benchmark':torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark,'allow_tf32':torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32})
native_inf=api.segmentation_inference
native_build=api._build_dataset
native_temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory
record={}
def traced_dataset(cfg,stage,*args,**kwargs):
    ds=native_build(cfg,stage,*args,**kwargs)
    name=ds.movie_names[0]
    x=ds.preprocess_sample_gpu(0,0,3,torch.device('cuda:0'))
    record['dataset']={'stage':stage,'movie_name':name,'shape_txyz':ds.movies_im[0].shape,'dtype':str(ds.movies_im[0].dtype),'raw_min':float(ds.movies_im[0].min()),'raw_max':float(ds.movies_im[0].max()),'input_channels_config':list(ds.input_channels),'actual_first_sequence_raw_frames':[0,1,2],'first_prediction_frame':2,'default_scale':ds.default_scale,'target_scale':ds.target_scale,'resolved_resize':ds.get_movie_scale(name),'target_shape':ds._compute_target_shape(ds.movies_im[0].shape,name),'prepared_shape':list(x.shape),'prepared_min':float(x.min()),'prepared_max':float(x.max()),'prepared_mean':float(x.mean()),'prepared_std':float(x.std()),'time_padding':ds.time_axis_padding,'normalization':ds.renorm,'crop_size':ds.crop_size,'checkpoint_scale_mode':record['mode'],'scale_file':ds.scale_file,'scale_entries':ds.movies_scale}
    if name in movies and ds.movies_im[0].shape[0]>3:
        disk=tifffile.imread(movies[name][0])
        record['dataset']['api_tiff_roundtrip_exact']=np.array_equal(ds.movies_im[0],np.swapaxes(disk,-1,-3))
        del disk
    del x
    return ds
def traced_inference(*args,**kwargs):
    predictions=native_inf(*args,**kwargs)
    p=out/(record['name']+'.tif')
    assert not p.exists(),p
    tifffile.imwrite(p,predictions[0],metadata={'axes':'TZYX'})
    a=predictions[0]
    record['probability']={'path':p,'sha256':sha(p),'min':float(a.min()),'max':float(a.max()),'dtype':str(a.dtype),'shape':list(a.shape),'voxels_above_half':int(np.count_nonzero(a>0.5))}
    return predictions
profiles=[('movie_I2_napari','movie_I2',0.25,'checkpoint_default',None,None),
          ('movie_I2_offline_overlap','movie_I2',0.5,'checkpoint_default',None,None),
          ('movie_M_napari','movie_M',0.25,'checkpoint_default',None,None),
          ('movie_M_offline_overlap','movie_M',0.5,'checkpoint_default',None,None),
          ('movie_I2_physical_probe','movie_I2',0.25,'source',[0.208,0.208,1],3),
          ('movie_M_physical_probe','movie_M',0.25,'source',[0.2076,0.2076,1],3)]
for label,name,overlap,mode,spacing,limit in profiles:
    print('BEGIN GPU',label,flush=True)
    assert not (out/(label+'.json')).exists()
    stack=tifffile.imread(movies[name][0])
    if limit: stack=stack[:limit]
    record={'name':label,'movie':name,'overlap':overlap,'batch_size':4,'mode':mode,'threshold':0.5,'weighted_cutoff':0.1,'physical_default':spacing,'probe_only':bool(limit),'preset_mode_at_promoted_path':release_segmentation_scale_mode('neural_tube',ckpt)}
    started=time.perf_counter()
    with patch.object(api,'_build_model',return_value=model),patch.object(api,'_build_dataset',side_effect=traced_dataset),patch.object(api,'segmentation_inference',side_effect=traced_inference),patch.object(api.tempfile,'TemporaryDirectory',side_effect=functools.partial(native_temp,dir=out/'temp')):
        detections=large_stack(lambda:api.infer_stack(stack,seg_checkpoint=str(ckpt),reg_checkpoint=None,device='gpu',overlap=overlap,batch_size=4,threshold=0.5,min_weighted_prob=0.1,scale_file=str(repo/'data/3D/scales.json'),default_scale=spacing,segmentation_scale_mode=mode,movie_name=name))
    record['elapsed_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-started
    record['detections']=detections
    record['center_count']=len(detections)
    save(label+'.json',record)
    print('GPU COMPLETE',label,'n=',len(detections),'max=',record['probability']['max'],'seconds=',round(record['elapsed_seconds'],2),flush=True)
    del stack,detections
    gc.collect(); torch.cuda.empty_cache()
